sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body:
Kaspilo is a personal-finance app. It is run by Yonatan Hershko as a private individual (the "operator", "we"). You can reach us by email: MyKaspilo@gmail.com.
By signing up for Kaspilo or using it, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy in section 9. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

sections.title: 2. What Kaspilo does
sections.body:
• Kaspilo helps you log income and expenses, set budgets, save toward goals and see statistics.
• You can keep up to 4 separate wallets (for example personal and business). Each wallet has its own categories, transactions, budgets and goals.
• Kaspilo is a tool for logging and tracking only. It is not financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Your money decisions are your own responsibility. Before a major decision, ask a licensed advisor.
• Every number in the app is calculated from the data you enter. If the data is wrong, the results will be wrong too.
• Kaspilo does not connect to your bank account and does not make payments for you.

sections.title: 3. Sign-up and account
sections.body:
• You sign up with a name, an email address and a password.
• Keep your password safe. You are responsible for everything done in your account.
• There is no age limit. A user under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's consent to pay for a subscription.
• One account is for one person. You may not transfer or sell an account.

sections.title: 4. Subscription and payment
sections.body:
• Access to Kaspilo is a subscription bought in the app through the App Store (Apple) or Google Play: monthly or yearly. The price is shown on the payment screen before you pay.
• A new subscription starts with a 14-day free trial, once per Apple or Google account. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the store charges the price of the plan you chose.
• The subscription renews by itself at the end of each period until you cancel it. You cancel in the subscription settings of the App Store or Google Play. Access stays until the end of the period you paid for.
• Payment is handled by Apple or Google under their terms. We never see your card details.
• If a payment fails, the store tries again for a while and access continues meanwhile. If it still fails, access is blocked.
• The operator may, at its discretion, grant access without payment or without an expiry date.
• If access ends, the app is locked. Your data is not deleted: you can export it from the locked screen, and it is kept until you delete your account.
• If the price changes, the store tells you in advance, as its rules require.

sections.title: 5. Cancellation and refunds
sections.body:
• Refunds for subscriptions bought in the app are handled by Apple or Google under their refund rules. Ask through the store: for Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com, for Google in your Google Play order history.
• Your rights under the Israeli Consumer Protection Law are kept. For help, email MyKaspilo@gmail.com.
• If a refund is given, access ends at once. Your data is kept.
• Cancelling the subscription in the store stops the next charges. It does not delete your account; to delete it, see section 6.
• If we stop running Kaspilo altogether, we will tell you in advance and stop the subscription renewing.

sections.title: 6. Your data
sections.body:
• The data you enter belongs to you.
• Export: while your subscription is active, you can export the open wallet's transactions to an Excel file (CSV) from More → History and export, and any wallet's transactions from More → Wallets. If your access is blocked, you can export all your data from the locked screen.
• Deletion: you can delete your account at any time from More → Delete account. Deletion is final and cannot be undone. It covers all wallets, transactions, categories, budgets, goals and the account itself.
• You can also delete a single wallet from More → Wallets. That deletion is final too: it removes all the data in that wallet, and your other wallets stay as they are.
• We back up the system regularly, but we cannot promise that data will never be lost. Export a backup from time to time.

sections.title: 7. Prohibited use
sections.body:
You may not:
• Try to access other users' data or get around the subscription lock.
• Hack, disrupt or overload the system, or run scripts and bots against it.
• Copy, decompile or reverse engineer the app, except where the law allows it.
• Use the app for any unlawful purpose.

sections.title: 8. Suspension and account closure
sections.body:
• If you break these terms, we may suspend or close your account. Before that, we will send you a notice and let you explain, unless the breach is serious or puts other users at risk.
• If your account is closed, you can ask for your data by email.

sections.title: 9. Privacy
sections.body:
What we keep:
• Your name and email.
• The wallets, transactions, categories, budgets and goals you enter.
• Your settings: language, theme, currency and reminders.
• Your subscription status (plan, trial, renewal date) and when you accepted the terms. Never your card details.
• A push-notification token, if you allowed notifications.
• App usage data: when you opened the app and when you signed up, with the device type (iPhone or Android) and the app version. We count app use, not your money: amounts, categories and wallets are never included.
Why: only to run the app, manage your subscription, send reminders and understand how many people use Kaspilo.
What we do not do: we do not sell data, show ads or share data with marketers.
Who processes data for us:
• Supabase hosts the database on cloud servers outside Israel.
• Expo, Apple and Google deliver notifications.
• Apple and Google handle subscription payments. RevenueCat checks store subscriptions for us; it gets your account id, not your name or email.
Security: each user sees only their own data. The connection is encrypted.
Your rights: you can view, correct, export and delete your data. For any such request, email MyKaspilo@gmail.com.

sections.title: 10. Availability and changes to the service
sections.body:
• We try to keep the app available at all times, but outages and maintenance downtime can happen.
• We may improve and change the app. If we remove a core feature, we will tell you in advance.

sections.title: 11. Liability
sections.body:
• The app is provided as is. We do our best to keep the calculations correct, but we do not promise there will be no mistakes.
• To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to what you paid for the subscription in the 12 months before the event.
• This limit does not apply to harm caused on purpose or by gross negligence.

sections.title: 12. Intellectual property
sections.body: The design, code, logo and the name Kaspilo belong to the operator. You get a personal right to use the app while your subscription is active.

sections.title: 13. Changes to these terms
sections.body:
• If we change these terms, we will tell you in the app or by email at least 14 days before the change takes effect.
• If the change is material, we will ask you to accept the terms again.

sections.title: 14. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Israeli law. To the extent the law allows, the competent courts of the Tel Aviv district have jurisdiction.

sections.title: 15. Contact
sections.body: For any question, request or complaint: MyKaspilo@gmail.com
